title: Held Out From What? Evaluating Distribution Shift Relative to Training Exposure in AI-Generated Code Detection: research artifact
description:
Research artifact accompanying the article "Held Out From What? Evaluating Distribution Shift Relative to Training Exposure in AI-Generated Code Detection", submitted to the Journal of Systems and Software.

Contains the full detection pipeline, the corpus construction, the exposure audit of a published detector's stated training split, the five evaluation conditions, the matched-twin control and every analysis reported in the article. Per-condition probability arrays are included for all arms, seeds and conditions, so every table and figure in the article can be regenerated without repeating model inference. A numbers ledger traces each of the 447 numeric values in the manuscript to the file that produced it.

No corpus is redistributed. DroidCollection, CodeMirage, AIGCodeSet and the DroidDetect weights are obtained from their own sources under their own terms, and the repository documents where each is placed.
